== Title ==
<span lang="ja">Ｘウイング</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-146o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">能力値１の専属パイロットが乗っている。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">インコム社のＴ－６５型。亡命した設計チームによって同盟軍に配備された。全長１２．５ｍ。攻撃範囲をより広くするために、Ｘ型に翼を展開する。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' X-wing.

'''Card text:''' Has a permanent pilot with ability 1.

'''Lore:''' Incom's T-65 model. Its defecting design team supplied it to the Alliance. It is 12.5 meters long. The wings spread into an X to broaden its attack coverage.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 2
* '''Printed subtype:''' Starfighter
* '''Power:''' 3
* '''Maneuver:''' 4
* '''Hyperspeed:''' 5
* '''Deploy:''' 2
* '''Forfeit:''' 4

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
